subject: Redwood evaluation kickoff — next steps & proposed dates
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@finlytics.com>
Cc: Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-01T17:12:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood evaluation kickoff — next steps & proposed dates

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the productive discovery call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get your evaluation kicked off: 

Recap from today
- Primary use case: contextual summarization for investor reports + retrieval-augmented generation for internal analyst workflows.
- Success criteria mentioned: (1) >= 90% accuracy on summary sanity checks vs. human baseline, (2) 2x improvement in analyst time-to-insight on pilot prompts, (3) stable latency under 800ms p50 for typical queries.
- Data & security: you clarified that data will remain in your VPC during the trial and that a SOC 2 + additional questionnaire will be required.

Proposed evaluation kickoff (what we want to accomplish)
- 45–60 min intro + trial plan: confirm success criteria, share evaluation timeline (2 weeks), collect prompt set and sample data, agree on rollouts and monitoring.
- Tech attendees: Connor (SE) to cover architecture & deployment options, Neha (CS) for onboarding and evaluation ops.

Available slots (PT) — please pick one that works or suggest alternatives:
- Wed Aug 4: 10:00–11:00 or 15:00–16:00
- Thu Aug 5: 10:00–11:00 or 14:00–15:00

Attachments: I’ve attached a short mutual action plan (Finlytics-MAP.pdf) to outline owners and timeline. Also attaching our standard compliance questionnaire; feel free to send any items you want prioritized.

If the team is happy with Thu Aug 5 10:00 PT, we’ll schedule a technical kickoff + demo and Connor will cover the deep dive.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

--
Attachment: Finlytics-MAP.pdf (1 page, PDF)
Attachment: Finlytics-Compliance-Questionnaire.pdf (Excel)

From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@finlytics.com>

Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@finlytics.com>
Date: 2027-08-02T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood evaluation kickoff — next steps & proposed dates

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the recap, this looks good. Thu Aug 5 at 10:00 PT works best for our team — please lock that in.

A couple quick asks for the kickoff so we can prepare: 
- Can Connor include a short segment on private deployment options (VPC vs. hosted) and key operational controls (audit logs, KMS integration)? Our security team will join for that piece.
- We’ll upload an initial prompt set (~20 prompts) and a small sample of redacted documents for the pilot. Where should we drop those? A temporary S3 link or secure upload works.

I’ll loop in our security lead Samir on the compliance questionnaire — he may have a few clarifying Qs.

Appreciate it — see you Thu.

Best,
Alex Chen
Head of AI | Finlytics
alex.chen@finlytics.com

From: Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>

Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Redwood evaluation kickoff — proposed agenda and ask list

Alex / Marissa —

Thanks — I’ll be on the call Thu Aug 5 10:00 PT. Below is a proposed technical agenda and prep list so we make the most of the 60 minutes: 

Proposed technical agenda (30–40 min)
- 10m: Architecture overview & deployment options (hosted API vs. private VPC vs. on-prem package)
- 10m: Data flow & security controls (KMS/HSM, audit logs, retention, network diagrams)
- 10m: Demo: model selection, quantization options, and batching vs latency tradeoffs
- 10m: Q&A and next steps for trial environment setup

Prep / ask for Finlytics
- Please share the prompt set (CSV or doc) and a redacted sample dataset placeholder (S3 link or secure upload).
- If possible, a short list of the top 5 prompts you want us to evaluate first — that helps focus the pilot.

I’ve attached a short kickoff agenda doc (kickoff-agenda.pdf) with timeboxed bullets and who will present each section. I can also bring our platform SRE (if you want deeper infra questions).

Connor Obrien
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com | (650) 555-0199
